an9.11:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an9.11:1.2: athakho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.11:1.5: yassa dāni tvaṃ sāriputta kālaṃ maññasīti.
an9.11:1.6: athakho so āyasmā sāriputto uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an9.11:1.7: athakho aññataro bhikkhu acirapakkante āyasmante sāriputte bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.11:1.8: āyasmā maṃ bhante sāriputto āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkantoti.
an9.11:1.10: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena sāriputtaṃ āmantehi
an9.11:1.12: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an9.11:1.14: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā sāriputto tassa bhikkhuno paccassosi.
an9.11:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca ānando apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihāraṃ āhiṇḍanti
an9.11:2.3: idānāyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sīhanādaṃ nadissatīti.
an9.11:2.4: athakho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an9.11:2.5: idha te sāriputta aññataro sabrahmacārī khīyadhammaṃ āpanno
an9.11:2.6: āyasmā maṃ bhante sāriputto āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkantoti.
an9.11:3.1: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa soṃ idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āsajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya
an9.11:4.1: seyyathāpi bhante paṭhaviyaṃ sucimpi nikkhipanti asucimpi nikkhipanti gūthagatampi nikkhipanti muttagatampi nikkhipanti kheḷagatampi nikkhipanti pubbagatampi nikkhipanti lohitagatampi nikkhipanti na ca tena paṭhavī aṭṭiyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:4.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante paṭhavīsamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena
an9.11:4.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:5.1: seyyathāpi bhante āpasmiṃ sucimpi dhovanti asucimpi dhovanti gūthagatampi muttagatampi kheḷagatampi pubbagatampi lohitagatampi dhovanti na ca tena āpo aṭṭiyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:5.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante āposamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena
an9.11:5.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:6.1: seyyathāpi bhante tejo sucimpi ḍahati asucimpi ḍahati gūthagatampi muttagatampi kheḷagatampi pubbagatampi lohitagatampi ḍahati na ca tena tejo aṭṭiyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:6.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante tejosamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena
an9.11:6.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:7.1: seyyathāpi bhante vāyo sucimpi upavāyati asucimpi upavāyati gūthagatampi muttagatampi kheḷagatampi pubbagatampi lohitagatampi upavāyati na ca tena vāyo aṭṭiyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:7.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante vāyosamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena
an9.11:7.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:8.1: seyyathāpi bhante rajoharaṇaṃ sucimpi muñcati asucimpi muñcati gūthagatampi muttagatampi kheḷagatampi pubbagatampi lohitagatampi muñcati na ca tena rajoharaṇaṃ aṭṭiyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā
an9.11:8.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante rajoharaṇasamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena
an9.11:8.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:9.1: seyyathāpi bhante caṇḍālakumārako vā caṇḍālakumārikā vā kaḷopihattho nantikavāsī gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisanto nīcacittaṃ yeva upaṭṭhapetvā pavisati
an9.11:9.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante caṇḍālakumārakasamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena
an9.11:9.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:10.1: seyyathāpi bhante usabho chinnavisāṇo surato sudanto susikkhito rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ anvāhiṇḍanto na kiñci hiṃsati pādena vā visāṇena vā
an9.11:10.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante usabhachinnavisāṇasamena cetasā viharāmi vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena
an9.11:10.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:11.1: seyyathāpi bhante itthī vā puriso vā daharo vā yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe ālaggena aṭṭiyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya
an9.11:11.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante iminā pūtikāyena aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi jigucchāmi
an9.11:11.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyya.
an9.11:12.1: seyyathāpi bhante puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chiddāvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ
an9.11:12.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi chiddāvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ
an9.11:12.3: yassa nūna bhante kāye kāyagatā sati anupaṭṭhitā assa so idha aññataraṃ sabrahmacāriṃ āpajja appaṭinissajja cārikaṃ pakkameyyāti.
an9.11:13.1: athakho so bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.11:13.2: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yo ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhiṃ
an9.11:13.3: tassa me bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
an9.11:13.4: taggha taṃ bhikkhu accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yo tvaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhi
an9.11:13.5: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhikkhu accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi tantaṃ mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
an9.11:13.6: vuḍḍhi hesā bhikkhu ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatī saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti
an9.11:14.2: khama sāriputta imassa moghapurisassa punāyaṃ tattheva sattadhā muddhā phalissatīti.
an9.11:14.3: khamāmahaṃ bhante tassa āyasmato sace mamaṃ so āyasmā evamāha
